Your email must also be valid, and your username must be unique. Once you are 
ready press register, and you will be taken to Figure 86. 
 
 
 
Figure 85 Email Verification part 1 
 
Figure 86 Email Verification part 2 
 
Figure 85, if you have just come from the sign in page, you must enter your 
username, and you will be taken to the next page. 
Figure 86, here you will receive an email with a code. If you have not received 
an email, please check your spam or junk folders. You may also resend your 
code by pressing the resend code button. Enter your code into the code field, 
and press verify, if successful you will be redirected to the login page.
